steps.say: Angstrom Signals has a community alongside: a live stream of social signals, and chat.
The arrow on the right edge opens it. | Other members' posts are blurred in this video.
The stream collects everyone's takes on assets and markets: agreeing or disagreeing with the AI's sentiment, with a short comment.
Filter it by positive, negative or mixed, by asset, or by person.
Below it is the chat. | Talk to everyone, to one of your communities, or privately to one person.
Write up to a hundred and sixty characters, add a face, and post. | Keep it friendly: no promoting, and no financial advice.
Pin the panel to keep it open beside the dashboard, or pop it out into its own window.
